## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic completed 31 captures during August 2023. Activity was recorded against the planned session schedule, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available information indicates that the site maintained routine operational activity throughout the month. No additional operational issues are recorded in the report.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 2 ungradable captures. This represents an ungradable rate of 6.5. The ungradable images could not be included in the grading outcome. The result is noted for monitoring alongside future site activity and image-quality performance.

## Grading

Grading identified 7 referable results from the captures reviewed. The median lag between capture and grading was 1. This provides the summary measure for the time taken to complete grading during August 2023. The findings should be considered together with the image-quality result, as 2 captures were ungradable and therefore did not contribute to the grading assessment.
